@font-face {
  font-family: "Table Kai";
  src: url("__TABLE_MEDIA_0__") format("woff2");
  font-weight: 400 800;
  font-display: swap;
}
@font-face { font-family:"Table Sans"; src:url("__TABLE_MEDIA_1__") format("woff2"); font-weight:400 700; font-display:swap; }
@font-face { font-family:"Table Figures"; src:url("__TABLE_MEDIA_2__") format("woff2"); font-weight:400 800; font-display:swap; }
@font-face { font-family:"Table Lettering"; src:url("__TABLE_MEDIA_3__") format("woff2"); font-weight:400; font-display:swap; }
:root {
  color-scheme: light;
  --serif:"Table Kai", "Kaiti SC", KaiTi, "Songti SC", serif;
  --sans:"Table Sans", "HarmonyOS Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --digits:"Table Figures", var(--sans);
  --lettering:"Table Lettering", Georgia, serif;
  --card-ratio: calc(63.5 / 88);
  --weave: none;
  --wood: none;
  --lift-ease: cubic-bezier(.19,.68,.27,1);
  --lower-ease: cubic-bezier(.28,.08,.36,1);
  --ink: #3c291b;
  --ivory: #f9edcd;
  --surface-w: 100vmax;
  --surface-h: 100vmin;
  --edge-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
  --edge-right: env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px);
  --edge-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
  --edge-left: env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px);
  font-size: min(calc(var(--surface-w) * .0128), calc(var(--surface-h) * .02064516), 26.4px);
}
@supports (width: 100dvmax) {
  :root { --surface-w: 100dvmax; --surface-h: 100dvmin; }
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { width:100%; height:100%; overflow:hidden; margin:0; touch-action:pan-x pan-y; }
body { position: relative; background: #332419; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--sans); -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; overscroll-behavior: none; }
button, input { font: inherit; }
button { appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; }
button:disabled { cursor: default; }
button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4992f; outline-offset: 2px; }
button, img { -webkit-touch-callout: none; }
#playfield { user-select:none; -webkit-user-select:none; touch-action:none; }
.icon, .gicon { display: inline-block; width: 1em; height: 1em; flex: none; vertical-align: -.13em; }
#vector-library { position: absolute; overflow: hidden; width: 0; height: 0; pointer-events: none; }
#surface {
  position:absolute; left:50vw; top:50vh; left:50dvw; top:50dvh;
  width:var(--surface-w); height:var(--surface-h); isolation:isolate;
  transform:translate(-50%, -50%); transform-origin:center;
  -webkit-text-size-adjust:100%; text-size-adjust:100%;
  container: tabletop / size; overflow:hidden;
  background: #ad906c;
  --side-inset: max(var(--edge-left), var(--edge-right));
  padding:var(--edge-top) var(--side-inset) var(--edge-bottom);
}
#surface::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -2; pointer-events: none;
  background:var(--mat-image,var(--table-map)) center/100% 100% no-repeat;
}
#surface::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 2.5rem #25180b44; }
#playfield {
  width: 100%; height: 100%; display: grid; position: relative; padding: 4.6cqh 3.75cqw 5.1cqh;
  --station-columns: minmax(0, 1.12fr) minmax(0, 4.05fr) minmax(0, 1.12fr);
  --station-gap: 1.22rem;
  grid-template-columns: var(--station-columns);
  grid-template-rows: minmax(0, .74fr) minmax(0, 3.09fr) minmax(0, .85fr);
  grid-template-areas: ". nobles tools" "left market right" ". bank ."; gap: .77rem var(--station-gap);
  --middle-max: calc(var(--surface-h) * 1.19);
}
#playfield::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 4.35% 2.85%; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(125deg, #f2dfbb60, #ede2c339 55%, #e9d6b44a); }
#toolbar { grid-area: tools; display: flex; align-self: center; justify-self: center; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .38rem; }
#toolbar button {
  position: relative; width: 2.18rem; height: 2.18rem; flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%;
  color: #493421; border: 1px solid #694b28; padding: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 33% 15%, #ead8a3, #c4a572 62%, #927346);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 .1rem #f3ddb2a8, inset 0 0 0 .17rem #a18354, 0 .13rem 0 #664a2c, 0 .22rem .29rem #47311f6b;
}
#toolbar .icon { width: 1.12rem; height: 1.12rem; stroke-width: 1.75; filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 0 #f9deb399); }
#market-table { grid-area: market; width: 100%; height: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; max-width: var(--middle-max); justify-self: center; container-type: size; }
.patrons-zone { grid-area: nobles; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 100%; height: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; max-width: var(--middle-max); justify-self: center; }
.noble-tray { --noble-gap:.82rem; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:stretch; gap:var(--noble-gap); width:87%; height:83%; max-height:6.15rem; min-width:0; min-height:0; }
.noble-tray > .noble-tile { flex:0 0 calc((100% - 2 * var(--noble-gap)) / 3); }
.noble-tile { position: relative; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; display: block; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; text-align: left; }
.noble-face { position:absolute; inset:.03rem 0; display:flex; align-items:center; min-width:0; pointer-events:none; transition:transform .19s var(--lift-ease), opacity .16s; }
.noble-tile::before { content:""; position:absolute; inset:13% 2% 10% 5%; border-radius:.4rem; pointer-events:none; background:#67543a; box-shadow:0 .19rem .34rem #67543a; opacity:0; transform:translateY(0) scale(.94); transition:opacity .16s, transform .19s var(--lift-ease); }
.noble-tile.is-invited::before { opacity:.23; transform:translateY(.18rem) scale(.97); }
.noble-tile.eligible-visitor .portrait-wrap { box-shadow:0 0 0 .09rem #d9bc7f,0 .13rem .22rem #4e47356b; }
.noble-tile.is-invited .noble-face { transform:translateY(clamp(-6px,-.32rem,-3px)) scale(1.025); }
#surface[data-phase="noble"] .noble-tile:not(.eligible-visitor) .noble-face { opacity:.66; }
.noble-face::before {
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:12% 0 10% 13%; pointer-events:none;
  clip-path:polygon(0 5%,96% 0,100% 5%,95.5% 50%,100% 94%,96% 100%,0 95%);
  background:linear-gradient(178deg,#e6cfa0 0 1%,transparent 6% 94%,#c2a579 99%),
    var(--weave),linear-gradient(105deg,#cdb791,#f6efd9 54%,#eee2c7);
  background-size:auto,6rem,auto; background-blend-mode:normal,soft-light,normal;
}
.portrait-wrap {
  position: relative; display: block; flex: none; width: min(43%, 4.7rem); height: 102%; border-radius: 49%;
  padding: .23rem; border: 1px solid #725531;
  background: linear-gradient(124deg, #ab8551 5%, #f2d398 23%, #ad8548 34%, #dbc28d 50%, #8e6a3d 71%, #eac790 88%, #977949);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #ead19b, 0 .16rem .27rem #51371d8f;
}
.portrait-wrap img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center 29%; border: 1px solid #755e38; border-radius: inherit; }
.noble-arrival-stage {
  position:absolute; inset:0; overflow:hidden; pointer-events:auto; touch-action:manipulation;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,#5b3b1b52 0%,#392a1e87 65%,#231b1699);
}
.noble-arrival-light {
  position:absolute; left:50%; top:50%; translate:-50% -50%; aspect-ratio:1; pointer-events:none;
}
[data-piece="noble"] > .portrait-wrap { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; }
.noble-arrival-stage::after {
  content:""; position:absolute; left:50%; top:50%; translate:-50% -50%; width:min(100vmin,760px);
  aspect-ratio:1; pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(closest-side,#fff0ba 42%,#ffe3a17a 60%,#ffe3a100 98%);
}
.noble-arrival-name {
  position:absolute; z-index:1; left:50%; top:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); padding:3px 18px 4px;
  white-space:nowrap; font:700 clamp(13px,2.8vmin,21px)/1.2 var(--serif); color:#483419;
  clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,97% 50%,100% 100%,0 100%,3% 50%);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#c4a368,#f8e8bd 26% 74%,#c4a368);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px #f9ebc9,inset 0 -1px #806337; pointer-events:none;
}
.noble-paper { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: start; min-width: 0; flex: 1; padding: 0 .3rem 0 .32rem; }

.has-portrait-row .guest-seals { display:flex; }
/* Once a noble has visited, both ledgers keep their score and wallet on the same lines. */
.guest-seals:empty::before, .guest-portrait { flex:0 0 var(--portrait-width); aspect-ratio:.94; min-width:0; }
.guest-seals:empty::before { content:""; visibility:hidden; }
.guest-portrait {
  position:relative; display:block; padding:0; border:0; border-radius:50%;
  background:linear-gradient(130deg,#a28350,#e7d2a0 30%,#a28958 65%,#7b6140);
  box-shadow:0 .09rem .15rem #49392342;
}
.guest-seal {
  position:absolute; inset:1px; width:calc(100% - 2px); height:calc(100% - 2px); display:block;
  object-fit:cover; object-position:center 29%; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid #a68b60; pointer-events:none;
}
@supports (object-view-box: inset(0% 13% 24% 13%)) {
  .guest-seal { object-view-box:inset(0% 13% 24% 13%); }
}
.guest-portrait:active { filter:brightness(.94); }
@media (pointer:coarse) {
  .guest-portrait::after { content:""; position:absolute; inset:-3px calc(-.5 * var(--portrait-gap)); }
  .guest-portrait:first-child::after { left:-5px; }
  .guest-portrait:last-child::after { right:-5px; }
}
@container tabletop (height < 450px) {
  .has-portrait-row .ledger-leaf { padding-block:.28rem .22rem; }
  .has-portrait-row .seat-prestige { padding-block:.25rem .17rem; }
  .has-portrait-row .asset-heading { padding-block:.22rem .16rem; }
  .has-portrait-row .deed-heading { margin-top:.10rem; }
  .has-portrait-row .holdings-button { margin-top:.24rem; }
}
@container tabletop (height < 450px) and (min-aspect-ratio:17/10) {
  .has-portrait-row .seat-profile { flex-direction:row; gap:.28rem; min-height:2.42rem; }
  .has-portrait-row .seat-profile .seat-seal { flex:none; width:1.8rem; height:2.12rem; margin:0; }
  .has-portrait-row .seat-profile h2 { min-width:0; margin:0; }
}
@container tabletop (height < 350px) and (min-aspect-ratio:17/10) {
  .ledger.has-portrait-row { padding-block:.30rem .27rem; }
  .has-portrait-row .seat-profile { min-height:2.16rem; }
  .has-portrait-row .guest-seals { padding-block:0; }
  .has-portrait-row .deed-heading { margin-top:0; }
  .has-portrait-row .holdings-button { min-height:21px; }
}
@container tabletop (width < 1050px) or (height < 605px) {
  .asset-heading { font-size:max(.82rem,10px); }
  .wallet-well { max-width:3.14rem; }
  .stack-qty { min-width:max(1.1rem,12px); height:max(1.1rem,12px); font-size:max(.89rem,10px); }
  .deed-grid { min-height: max(2.5rem,22px); }
  .deed { width:100%; max-width:2.25rem; }
  .noble-name { font-size:max(.94rem,9px); }
  .noble-needs { --pip: max(1.05rem,12px); gap:.07rem; }
  .noble-needs .price { padding:0 .11em 0 .03em; gap:0; }
  .noble-needs .price-stone { width:.66em; }
  .card-price { --pip-limit: min(15.8cqh, 1.39rem); }
  .card-price .price b { font-size: min(max(10px, .85em), .98em); }
  .card-bonus { width:max(2.04rem,18px); height:max(2.04rem,18px); }
}
@container tabletop (width < 610px) {
  .noble-name { font-size:max(.92rem,7.5px); }
  .noble-needs { --pip:9px; }
  .wallet-well { max-width:2.65rem; }
  .asset-heading { padding-top:.31rem; font-size:max(.8rem,8px); }
  .seat-profile { min-height:3rem; }
  .seat-seal { height:1.85rem; }
  .deed-grid { min-height:1.9rem; }
  .card-price { --pip-limit: min(15.5cqh, 1.46rem); }
}

@container tabletop (height >= 450px) {
  .seat-prestige { padding-block:.62rem .50rem; }
  .wallet-grid { row-gap:clamp(5px,.64rem,11px); }
  .deed-heading { margin-top:.40rem; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; transition-duration: 0s !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
}
